+import warnings
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+from pvlib import location as pvlocation
+from pvlib import modelchain, pvsystem
+from pvlib.temperature import TEMPERATURE_MODEL_PARAMETERS
+from pvlib.tools import _golden_sect_DataFrame
+
+
+def _parabola(params, x):
+    # Ignore params; only the x values matter for this regression test.
+    return -(x - 3.0) ** 2
+
+
+def test_golden_sect_dataframe_equal_bounds_no_warning():
+    params = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([0]))
+
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error", RuntimeWarning)
+        opt_x, opt_f = _golden_sect_DataFrame(params, 0.0, 0.0, _parabola)
+
+    assert np.isclose(np.atleast_1d(opt_x)[0], 0.0)
+    assert np.isclose(np.atleast_1d(opt_f)[0], -9.0)
+
+
+def test_golden_sect_dataframe_mixed_bounds():
+    params = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([0, 1]))
+    lower = pd.Series([0.0, 0.0], index=params.index)
+    upper = pd.Series([0.0, 5.0], index=params.index)
+
+    opt_x, opt_f = _golden_sect_DataFrame(params, lower, upper, _parabola)
+
+    opt_x = np.atleast_1d(opt_x)
+    opt_f = np.atleast_1d(opt_f)
+
+    assert np.isclose(opt_x[0], 0.0)
+    assert np.isclose(opt_f[0], -9.0)
+    assert np.isclose(opt_x[1], 3.0, atol=1e-3)
+    assert np.isclose(opt_f[1], 0.0, atol=1e-3)
+
+
+def test_modelchain_zero_irradiance_single_row_runs():
+    temperature_model_parameters = TEMPERATURE_MODEL_PARAMETERS["sapm"][
+        "open_rack_glass_glass"
+    ]
+    modules = pvsystem.retrieve_sam("cecmod")
+    inverters = pvsystem.retrieve_sam("cecinverter")
+
+    module_parameters = modules["Trina_Solar_TSM_300DEG5C_07_II_"]
+    inverter_parameters = inverters["ABB__MICRO_0_25_I_OUTD_US_208__208V_"]
+
+    location = pvlocation.Location(latitude=51.204483, longitude=5.265472)
+    system = pvsystem.PVSystem(
+        module_parameters=module_parameters,
+        inverter_parameters=inverter_parameters,
+        temperature_model_parameters=temperature_model_parameters,
+    )
+    mc = modelchain.ModelChain(
+        system,
+        location,

+
